verdict.rationale: This is a state government business-registry and revenue agency. The records it holds are statutory public records kept by the state, so a user-selectable storage region is not a capability this kind of product would plausibly offer. Nothing in the evidence shows any data-residency option. References to NJ versus non-NJ foreign entities concern entity jurisdiction, not where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
